description: A curated knowledge base of our team's technical methodology — architecture decisions, implementation patterns, operational practices, and lessons learned. Each module captures HOW we approach a topic, not just what it means. Use the index to identify relevant modules, then load the ones you need. Prefer modules with higher confidence ratings. Cross-reference related modules when topics overlap.

architecture.name: architecture
architecture.description: Topics: anti-goals, architecture, boundaries, design-decision, federation, git, integration, isolation. Modules include: Design Boundaries: What KM Will Never Introduce; Multi-KB Federation: Namespace Isolation for Team Knowledge; Git-Native Storage: Why JSON Files Over Databases; MCP Protocol: Why Stdio Over HTTP Server

modules.title: Design Boundaries: What KM Will Never Introduce
modules.summary: KM has explicit anti-goals that define its identity: no vector databases, no SQL, no web servers, no message queues. These boundaries keep the project small and focused.

modules.title: Multi-KB Federation: Namespace Isolation for Team Knowledge
modules.summary: Multiple knowledge bases can be combined under a single MCP server with namespace prefixes. Each namespace has independent search, index, and health resources.

modules.title: Git-Native Storage: Why JSON Files Over Databases
modules.summary: KM stores all knowledge as JSON files in a Git repository, using the file system as the database and Git for versioning, sync, and audit.

modules.title: MCP Protocol: Why Stdio Over HTTP Server
modules.summary: KM exposes all functionality through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over stdio, not a web server. LLM agents connect directly to the MCP server as a subprocess.

operations.name: operations
operations.description: Topics: archive, deprecate, lifecycle, operations, review, status. Modules include: Module Lifecycle: Draft → Published → Deprecated → Archived

modules.title: Module Lifecycle: Draft → Published → Deprecated → Archived
modules.summary: Every knowledge module follows a five-state lifecycle with clear transitions, review gates, and search visibility rules at each stage.

search.name: search
search.description: Topics: bayesian, bm25, chinese, cjk, confidence, heuristic, i18n, jieba. Modules include: Chinese Word Segmentation: Jieba Integration for CJK Search; Search Ranking Pipeline: BM25 + Heuristic + Confidence + Bayesian

modules.title: Chinese Word Segmentation: Jieba Integration for CJK Search
modules.summary: KM uses jieba for Chinese word segmentation, allowing Chinese queries to match Chinese module content with proper word boundaries instead of treating entire sentences as single tokens.

modules.title: Search Ranking Pipeline: BM25 + Heuristic + Confidence + Bayesian
modules.summary: KM's search is a four-layer cascade: heuristic field-weighted scoring, confidence multiplier, Bayesian prior from telemetry, and BM25 for tie-breaking.
